[LGRA.12.3.1] In pattern-body position (after the type reference): the binding.
In expression position: a value-namespace reference resolved in the order
binding → constant → builtin function ([LGRA.22.7]); a `NAME` followed by `(` is
a builtin function call; an unresolved `NAME` is a compile error. A pattern head
that is not a type reference must be the `no` negation keyword, else a compile
error ("pattern must begin with a schema name or `no`"); an action head must be
an action keyword (`call`, `emit`, …), else a compile error.
